medtech_hero.headline: Building the future of maternal and child health.
medtech_hero.subline: NatalTech develops digital tools for prenatal monitoring and early pediatric follow-up across Latin America.

medtech_problem.problem_text: In Latin America, over 40% of perinatal complications could be prevented with continuous monitoring and timely access to clinical information. Rural and low-income mothers are most affected by the fragmentation of the healthcare system.
medtech_problem.vision_text: An integrated platform connecting doctors, patients, and data in real time — bridging the prenatal and pediatric care gap with accessible technology.

features.headline: Remote Prenatal Monitoring
features.desc: Low-cost devices and mobile app for tracking maternal vital signs from home. Early alerts for treating physicians.

features.headline: Digital Pediatric Record
features.desc: Unified child health record from birth. Vaccines, growth curves, and health alerts in one place.

features.headline: Smart Triage
features.desc: Risk classification algorithm that helps families decide when to go to the ER — reducing unnecessary visits by 35%.

medtech_founder.label: Founder
medtech_founder.name: Dr. Ana Laura Diaz
medtech_founder.bio: Independent physician with 8 years of experience in pediatrics and neonatal care. After witnessing the gaps in Panama's maternal and child health system firsthand, she founded NatalTech to create patient-centered technology solutions.
